reputation: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The service description does not name a reputation check.

sanctions: The wrapper readme says payTo is an exact match against the US OFAC list of digital currency addresses, and the answer includes the sanctions list version.
payto_catalogue: The wrapper readme says Factline records payTo wallets listed in the Coinbase x402 Bazaar and the Circle x402 catalogue. A known seller asking for an unlisted wallet gets review, or deny in strict mode.
price_sanity: The wrapper readme checks the amount against the seller's lowest listed price and against the caller's budget.
uptime: The wrapper readme includes Factline's nightly uptime probes, and the agents page also names age and uptime.
identity_binding: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The wrapper readme does not name ERC-8004 or another identity binding.
reputation: The wrapper readme reports paying wallets, calls in the last 30 days, and payers left after removing self payments. It does not call that history a reputation check.
verdict: The wrapper readme says the answer is allow, review, or deny.
failure_mode: The wrapper readme says failOpen defaults to true, so a payment proceeds when the guard cannot be reached. Strict mode sets failOpen to false and aborts the payment.
signed_verdict: The wrapper readme says every answer includes an Ed25519 signed verdict. The signature covers a JSON string with the decision, seller origin, payTo, amount, mode, list version, and time.
networks: The wrapper example registers the client on eip155:8453. The readme does not list every network the guard can check.
price: The agents page calls the pay guard free. The changelog entry of 2026-10-14 also calls it free.
license: The wrapper readme says MIT licence.
status: The changelog lists the pay guard on 2026-10-14 and a catalogue and signature update on 2026-10-20. The agents page still documents the check. Neither page applies a retired label.

sanctions: The facilitator screen returns block for an OFAC sanctioned payer or payee. A separate wallet risk call also screens OFAC. The free endpoint monitor names uptime, price, and payout wallet.
payto_catalogue: The quickstart says a swapped payout wallet is denied when the 402 names a wallet the monitor has not seen this seller use.
price_sanity: The quickstart example denies a payment when the amount is higher than the monitored price.
uptime: The features page says every monitored endpoint is checked every 30 minutes, including uptime.
identity_binding: The features page describes optional agent credentials that tell a seller the agent belongs to a verified company. It does not name ERC-8004 for the payee.
reputation: The features page grades an endpoint from uptime, response time, price and wallet stability, and paid delivery. It does not call that grade a reputation check.
verdict: The free check returns allow or deny. Paid authorization returns allow, deny, or review. The features page also maps letter grades to proceed, caution, or avoid.
failure_mode: The features page says the SDK wrapper fails closed if PayCheck cannot be reached. The quickstart says that if PayCheck cannot be reached, do not pay.
signed_verdict: Paid allow includes an Ed25519 signed receipt bound to the URL, amount, and payout wallet. The features page also says each paid test produces an Ed25519 signed receipt.
networks: The plans page says the payments it prices in USDC are on Base or Solana.
price: Endpoint checks are free. Builder is $9 a month and Business is $49 a month. The facilitator plan includes 10,000 checks a month, then $1.50 per 1,000 checks.
license: The repository README says the documentation, examples, and packages in the repository are MIT licensed. The hosted service is not covered by that license.
status: The plans page offers free checks and paid plans. It does not apply a beta or retired label.
